My research focuses on experimental and behavioural economics and decision theory, with a particular interest in how self-perception influences economic decision-making in labour market and search environments. I also have a broader interest in how artificial intelligence may reshape social norms. My research primarily employs experimental methods to test theoretical predictions and study individual behaviour, while I also conduct empirical research on related topics.
